summary: Independent review reproduced the original multiprocess name[] filtering failure on the recorded base and verified that the exact candidate fixes it. Repeated requested names return exactly the requested existing metric families, an unknown name is omitted, a single requested family works, and an unfiltered scrape remains complete. The dependency floor is updated across all six SGLang package variants found in the repository.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual SGLang add_prometheus_middleware with multiprocess files: unfiltered scrape returned three SGLang families, while repeated-name, single-name, and unknown-only filtered requests all returned empty bodies, reproducing the issue. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-review-j-cbc42102170b/evidence/base-reproduction.json

Repeated two-name plus unknown request returned only sglang:num_running_reqs and sglang:prompt_tokens_total; single-name returned only that family; unknown-only was empty; unfiltered retained all three families. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-review-j-cbc42102170b/evidence/candidate-regression.json

The same regression and adversarial cases passed with an isolated exact prometheus-client 0.25.0 install, validating the proposed minimum. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-review-j-cbc42102170b/evidence/candidate-prom025.json
Changed Python source and regression test compile successfully.
All 10 tests in the candidate's registered metrics module collect successfully. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-review-j-cbc42102170b/evidence/collect.txt

gpu_execution_evidence: No GPU execution was needed for this Python ASGI/Prometheus registry contract. The prepared host exposes one AMD Instinct MI350X with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2, but no numerical or model-architecture claim is part of this review. Environment evidence: /tmp/amdpilot-review-j-cbc42102170b/evidence/environment.txt
native_rebuild_reason: The exact candidate diff contains no C, C++, HIP, CUDA, or other native source changes; repository-environment.json also declares native=null. A native rebuild is not applicable.
remaining_limitations: The candidate's external Qwen-backed registered server test was collected but not executed in this independent review; the original failure and fix were instead exercised directly through SGLang's actual ASGI middleware with real prometheus multiprocess files.
No distributed serving workload was run. This does not limit the registry-level contract under review.
The separate gRPC aiohttp metrics sidecar is not implemented through make_asgi_app and is outside the original issue's stated HTTP endpoint contract.
